positions.name: PallasineChecklistEstablishment
positions.frame: how is the Pallasine checklist established as the onboarding standard?
positions.why: Both expressions are Wren Duskfield's authoritative assertions about the Pallasine checklist's status: src-3 states the universal mandate and its three-part content (accounts, pairing rotation, shadow shift), while src-4 supplies the provenance — it replaced the old wiki page last quarter. Together they perform a single directional read: Wren exercising informational authority to frame the checklist as the settled, load-bearing onboarding process, both what it requires and how it came to be.
